title: Applying STRIDE Threat Modeling to AI Agent Pipelines: A Systematic Mapping

original_idea.body:
# Applying STRIDE Threat Modeling to AI Agent Pipelines: A Systematic Mapping

**Problem:** STRIDE (Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Information Disclosure, Denial of Service, Elevation of Privilege) is a mature threat modeling framework. It has not been systematically applied to AI agent pipelines.

**Direction:** Take a standard multi-step agentic pipeline (web research + code execution + file management). Apply STRIDE to each component. For each identified threat, propose a monitoring signal that would detect it. Validate with simple experiments.

**Why it matters:** STRIDE provides a comprehensive threat enumeration that is likely to surface AI-agent-specific threats not previously identified. This is a force multiplier for monitoring design.

**Relevant context:** STRIDE threat modeling (Microsoft); LW ATT&CK-style analysis; agent pipeline security.
